title: A Witness for the Autopsy
author: Felix Kavanagh
blurb: Rafael Dunmore, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
